notes.title: Rogue Snake Joins Steam Next Fest! + Patch 0.3.4 Released
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I’m thrilled to announce that [b]Rogue Snake[/b] is now officially part of [b]Steam Next Fest – June 2025 Edition!
[/b]
If you haven’t yet, now’s the perfect time to try the [b]free demo[/b] and wishlist the game to follow my progress!

[b]Patch 0.3.4 is Live: Combo System & Bugfixes!
[/b]
Alongside the festival, I’ve released [b]Update 0.3.4 [/b]for the demo with some exciting new features and much-needed fixes:

[b]New: Combo System[/b]

- Every time you attack enemies quickly in succession, your [b]Combo[/b] builds up!
- Chaining attacks increases your combo points - and with that, your [b]score, credits and research points[/b].
- The combo meter will pop up dynamically, then fade when the action slows down. Timing matters!

[b]Bugfixes & Improvements[/b]

- Fixed several bugs related to UI and hit detection.
- Fixed several localisation issues.


[b]What's Next?[/b]

As I am preparing for the release of the full game later this summer I would appreciate any feedback you guys have! If you enjoy the game, please consider:

- [b]Wishlisting[/b] the game
- [b]Sharing feedback[/b] in the community hub
- [b]Leaving a review[/b] on the demo page
- [b]Telling a friend[/b] who loves roguelites or old-school Snake to play the game

Thanks so much for your support - I can’t wait to hear what you think during Next Fest!

Natrix

notes.title: Patch 0.3.2 is Live!
notes.notes:
Hey gamers!

I'm really happy that you're enjoying the Rogue Snake demo! I've received a lot of feedback about the difficulty curve and some UI bugs — which are addressed in this patch.

The changes to the demo are already live, and I hope you enjoy them! I'm looking forward to hearing more feedback from you.

Patch Notes:

[list]
[*]The initial speed of the Mecha Snake has been reduced by 30%.
[*]Enemy HP in Masteries 2 and 3 has been reduced by 35%.
[*]Fixed a bug where text would overflow outside some UI panels.
[*]Fixed a bug where merchant mods couldn't be selected using a gamepad or keyboard only.
[/list]

notes.notes:
Hi Gamers!

The Rogue Snake Demo is officially out! I am so exited to release the demo and can't wait to read what you all think about it! I really love this game and happy with what I achieved developing it and I really hope you will love it as much as I do!

Please, if you have something to say about it, any feedback: bugs, difficulty, progression, upgrades usefullnes, etc - tell me everthing you think!

With love, dev

notes.title: An early demo version was released on Itch
notes.notes:
Hi Gamers!

I am actively working on the demo version of Rogue Snake! It will be released on Steam later this month, but if you want to try it early - it is published on my itch io page and is available to download. There are certainly going to be some bugs and issues, but for the most part it works and is very fun to play!

https://stridergg.itch.io/rogue-snake
